hunter.title: Hunt where a herd holds, one hunter a herd; sell stored curd where a bid stands; gather iron only when no herd is open
hunter.note: Fit: the starter Pulse Laser I (reach 3) and Mining Laser I. Each hunt takes one ship (rule F9); the veil-ray, drift-ray and carapace hunts are standing work that store curd, carapace and biogas for the station list; the sell-curd routes open only while a bid stands and the pilot stores curd. Gathering is the fallback (rule F23).

guard.title: Guard where our ships mine beyond the border; read the guarded systems when no guard post is open
guard.note: A guard route opens only while a pilot of ours flies the route it guards; it never fires, leaves under 60 percent hull or in a fight, and docks at the station named. Put it before @hunter in a ship's cell.
